simple.meaning: דַּרְקוֹן (Darqôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Darkon , one of 'Solomon's servants'.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H1874. Darqon דַּרְקוֺן proper name, masculine head of a family of Nethinim , who went up with Zerubbabel, ׳בְּנֵידֿ Ezra 2:56 = Neh 7:58 . דרר (√ of following words: Arabic ; — 1 stream, flow abundantly (of milk, tears, rain, etc.), compare I. דְּרוֺר . 2 be abundant, luxuriant (of her-bage), compare a kind of tree, now elm (Lane), & דַּרְדַּר . 3 run vehemently, easily (of horse), compare swift horse, or other beast, & II. דְּרוֺר . 4 give light, shine (of lamp), compare shining star , glistening or shining of sword, pearls (collective) & דַּר ; hence probably דָּרוֺם ).
